description: Main source file for the game server logic of Unvanquished, including game initialization, shutdown, entity management, and configuration handling.

classes.name: level_locals_t
classes.description: Structure holding local level state information.

methods.name: CheckExitRules
methods.description: Function to check game exit conditions.

methods.name: G_LogGameplayStats
methods.description: Logs gameplay statistics based on game state.

methods.name: G_FindEntityGroups
methods.description: Chains entities with matching groupName for group management.

methods.name: G_InitSetEntities
methods.description: Initializes entities by calling their reset functions.

methods.name: G_MapConfigs
methods.description: Loads configuration scripts for the current map and layout.

methods.name: G_InitGame
methods.description: Performs game initialization, including entity setup, logging, and configuration loading.

methods.name: G_ClearVotes
methods.description: Removes all active votes, optionally for all or specific teams.

methods.name: G_VotesRunning
methods.description: Checks if any votes are currently active.

methods.name: G_ShutdownGame
methods.description: Handles game shutdown procedures, including logging and cleanup.

methods.name: G_PrepareEntityNetCode
methods.description: Prepares network code for entities, including spectators and non-spectators.

methods.name: G_NextMapCommand
methods.description: Determines the next map command based on cheat and devmap conditions.
